gui.mobexpansion.mob_drop_config.replace: ON: clear the vanilla/mod drop table and use only the entries below. OFF: add these drops on top of existing loot.
Filter every loaded mob by name or id, including vanilla (minecraft:zombie).
gui.mobexpansion.mob_drop_config.title: Mob settings: %s
gui.mobexpansion.mob_spawner.activation_: After the spawner's chunk loads, wait this many ticks before the first wave. 0 = spawn immediately.
Players farther than this (blocks) will not wake the spawner. Maximum 64.
Players closer than this (blocks) will not wake the spawner. 0 = no inner dead zone.
Extra per-mob range: the player must also be this close for THIS mob to be eligible. Separate from global activation distance.
gui.mobexpansion.mob_spawner.block_aroun: A spawn attempt succeeds only if this block is on one of the four sides of the spawn position. Empty = no check.
gui.mobexpansion.mob_spawner.block_under: If set, the whole spawner stays idle unless this block is directly below it. Empty = any block.
gui.mobexpansion.mob_spawner.check_heigh: Player must be within 16 Y of the spawner, and spawned mobs must also appear within 16 Y of the player.
gui.mobexpansion.mob_spawner.check_los.t: The spawner only wakes if it can see the player's eyes (no solid blocks in between).
gui.mobexpansion.mob_spawner.check_spect: Spectator players do not wake the spawner.
Remove camouflage. The spawner will look like a normal spawner again.
gui.mobexpansion.mob_spawner.count_max.t: Maximum mobs in one wave. The real count is random between min and max.
gui.mobexpansion.mob_spawner.count_min.t: Minimum mobs in one wave. The real count is random between min and max.
gui.mobexpansion.mob_spawner.done.toolti: Save this spawner to the world and close.
gui.mobexpansion.mob_spawner.enabled.too: If off, this mob stays in the set but never spawns.
Click to select and edit this mob. Drag to change Standard spawn order.
gui.mobexpansion.mob_spawner.interval.to: Ticks between spawn waves for this mob. 20 ticks = 1 second. Max 432000 (6 hours). Default 200 (10 seconds).
gui.mobexpansion.mob_spawner.mask.cycle_: Click to cycle, Shift-click to go back
gui.mobexpansion.mob_spawner.mask.hint: The spawner looks like this block in the world.
gui.mobexpansion.mob_spawner.mask.toolti: The spawner looks like this block to everyone. Only an OP holding a spawner item can see the real one.
gui.mobexpansion.mob_spawner.max_simulta: If this many living copies of this mob are already near the spawner, no more will spawn.
gui.mobexpansion.mob_spawner.move_down.t: Move the selected mob later in Standard spawn order.
gui.mobexpansion.mob_spawner.move_up.too: Move the selected mob earlier in Standard spawn order.
Already in the set. Dimmed rows are already added.
Click to add this mob to the spawner set.
gui.mobexpansion.mob_spawner.remove.tool: Remove the selected mob from this spawner's set.
gui.mobexpansion.mob_spawner.reset.toolt: Reset the entity set and all settings to defaults. Nothing is saved until you press Done.
gui.mobexpansion.mob_spawner.search.tool: Filter the picker by mob name or id (minecraft:zombie).
Each wave picks a random mob that currently meets its conditions.
Cycles through the set in list order. Use the up/down arrows to change priority.
gui.mobexpansion.mob_spawner.spawn_radiu: How far horizontally from the spawner this mob can appear, in blocks.
gui.mobexpansion.mob_spawner.spawn_y_max: Highest world Y where this mob can appear. Random between min and max.
gui.mobexpansion.mob_spawner.spawn_y_min: Lowest world Y where this mob can appear. Random between min and max. Default is one block above the spawner.
gui.mobexpansion.mob_spawner.tab.conditi: Reserved for later. Global wake rules (LOS, daylight, distance, blocks) are always on the right panel.
gui.mobexpansion.mob_spawner.tab.main.to: Per-mob numbers for the selected entry: interval, count, radii, Y.
Camouflage: which block the spawner looks like in the world, plus its blockstate.
